sgp_rule: Same-game parlays from this card's own rows, ordered by each slip's WEAKEST leg — that leg's own record at its exact line. ⛔ No combined chance is shown and no EV is: the legs are in one game, so multiplying their records would assert they are independent when they are not. parlay_rule: Legs are in DIFFERENT GAMES and at the SAME BOOK. Each leg's number is the props model's chance where it priced that prop and the player's own record otherwise (the leg's confidence_basis); the combined figure multiplies them, which assumes the games are unrelated.
